versions.changelog: Rewrites the storefront and Skill documentation for clearer GEO entity recognition, explicit activation boundaries, current-safe capability claims, canonical examples, and machine-readable query metadata. Removes stale CSV and evidence topics from the published positioning.
Adds explicit positive and negative activation examples and fixes the self-check version reference.
Single-file review-safe core that replaces the 1.1.0 review state with a fully analyzable static infographic workflow.

Adds a deterministic CSV, JSON-record, and Markdown-table path to an auditable five-file Share Pack: 16:9 HTML, 4:5 and 9:16 PNGs, evidence JSON, and a sourced caption. Includes three reproducible cases while preserving v1.0.2 injection, path, rendering, and permission hardening.
Single-file review-safe core with precise scope, static infographic specification, and standalone HTML source output.
Aligned declared scope with plan-based rendering, made language explicit, minimized data sharing, and removed non-runtime examples from the release artifact.

v1.0.2: addresses SkillSpector findings. Fixed LP3 (permissions now declared: no network, --out-only writes, local Chrome for optional PNG), SQP-3 (language is plan-driven, any locale renders correctly - Chinese-first is audience positioning), AST4 (Chrome launch flags documented as constant whitelist, numeric args int-coerced). Mitigated TP4/AE1 false positives with a Capability map table. No rendering behavior change; 10/10 demos pass.

v1.0.1: security hardening. ClawHub clawscan flagged an HTML/script injection risk in generated outputs; this version closes that path: brand_colors now accepted only as #RGB/#RRGGBB (anything else falls back to palette defaults, blocking style-tag escape), and infographic_id is sanitized before joining output paths. Injection-tested; all 10/10 demos still validate and render pixel-equivalent. No content, schema, or visual changes.

v1.0.0: positioning refresh + 2 bug fixes + terracotta hero. SKILL.md / README.md: 中文 0 错字 · plan 可改 · 6 版式, with vs-AI-image-gen comparison table. Renderer fixes (backward compatible, all 10/10 demos still validate): build_radial.center_svg only renders first summary (no more center-circle overlap); build_dashboard drops internal note_html so footer note renders once. New demo: infographic-flywheel-terracotta-hero.
Security hardening: safe palettes, network-free HTML rendering, least-privilege tooling, automatic language selection, and evidence sidecars.

Evidence now renders automatically in HTML and PNG with numbered sources, metric periods and baselines, typed and qualified claim bindings, annotations, and a colocated evidence JSON sidecar; legacy plans remain byte-compatible.
Added Evidence-first Data Storytelling with source, metric, claim, story arc, annotation schema, stronger validation, and a complete data-story example while preserving all v0.3 plans.

Premium visual skin layer: 2 new styles (data-journal, night-ops) riding on existing palette+emphasis system via CSS variables only — no content/layout/relation touched, keeping editable-plan + info-correct + embeddable narrative intact. SVG hardcoded colors variableized with identical defaults (zero regression). visual_system.premium_style enum added (backward compatible).
v0.2.1: 新增 PNG 分享图导出（render_infographic_png.py，通过 headless Chrome CDP 全页截图，零 Python 依赖，默认 2x 清晰度），补齐小红书/公众号/博客配图场景。HTML 仍是主要交付物，PNG 为派生分享图。
v0.2.0: 新增自包含 HTML 成品渲染（radial/spine-branch/pyramid/timeline/dashboard/sankey 6 种布局），默认交付 primary_target 从 whiteboard 改为 html，关闭『只有 plan 没有成品』的闭环缺口。
